verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted, open-source inference engine. It has no hosted account or persistent user-data store, so exporting all of your data to leave is a category error for this product type. Related openness signals, such as the OpenAI-compatible API and Hugging Face model formats, are adjacent and not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
